notes: This case strongly exercises evidence revision rather than hindsight reasoning. At stage 1 the gateway release, key rotation, and clock skew are all live alternatives. The half-fleet rollback legitimately refutes the gateway-version hypothesis at stage 2, while the mislabeled K1-only dumps make stale production JWKS state a warranted stage-2 belief. Stage 3 then explicitly invalidates that evidence, shows production caches contain K2, localizes rejected tokens to auth-2, and establishes mismatched signing material. The truth correctly preserves the reasonableness of earlier states and actions instead of rewriting them with later knowledge. Secret-sync causation remains unknown because the relevant logs are gone. The staged actions are reversible and appropriately evaluated as of their evidence stage. The case has multiple plausible alternatives, a meaningful evidence correction, no lexical answer leakage, and sufficient difficulty.
